Ti ricordiamo che hai la possibilità di riscattare il tuo vecchio PC. Per esercitare la prelazione è sufficiente confermarlo nel ticket, successivamente verrai contattato per eseguire una formattazione da remoto. Se ricevi una mail dove ti viene chiesto di restituire il vecchio, non preoccuparti puoi ignorarla. Il prezzo è di 60 € per PC e 160 € per MacOS. NOTE: Ricorda che la prelazione è valida se: Entro 7 giorni dalla data di creazione del presente ticket eserciti il tuo diritto di prelazione. ✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GHF Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the GHF/IT Infrastructure Department with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes

RESTRICTED
Description: Data not commonly available to outside user. Guests as a member in a team are not allowed.

RESTRICTED GST
Description: External sharing and collaboration in a Team, no confidential data. Use this team only for content that has to be shared with the guests. For other content not to be shared use a separate Team with classification No Guests.
Use case: Collaboration with a provider. Non-confidential client information

CONFIDENTIAL
Description: No external sharing available.
Use case: All - HOD team (not all to CMC), GMB meeting data, Trade secrets, strategic plans and presentations

CONFIDENTIAL GST
Description: Critical data only available to a limited set of people inside and outside of the organization. Use this team only for content that has to be shared with the guests. For other content not to be shared use a separate Team with classification No Guests. Sharing needs owner approval.
Use case: Mergers and acquisitions, projects with external consultants
- Classification of the team: Restricted

- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or stealing confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeated tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ The software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
❌ Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
❌ Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (e.g., viruses and malware

feedback.answer:
Hello,

Administrative rights must be requested through the **Local Administration Rights (LAR) request form**. Please submit the form with the following information:

- Confirm whether **long-term rights** are required for recurring development activities, or whether temporary rights are sufficient.
- Full name of your manager/project manager at **L6 level or above** for approval. If you are L6 or above, enter yourself as the approver.
- Computer name (Device Name in the Company Portal, or run `hostname` in Command Prompt).
- Operating system.
- Client and project name.
- Detailed justification and a complete list of the software/actions requiring elevated rights (for example, development tools, runtimes, database tools, environment configuration, and local environment setup).

Please first confirm with your manager that local administrator rights are permitted under the applicable client/project requirements. Only approved, business-related software may be installed, and you must maintain the security patches for any additionally installed software. Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.

Once the form is submitted with the required details and approval, Group IT can process the request.

Below you will find the additional form information for that request and the information you filled out.

- Need: Extra information needed to have a Full License to create boards
- Important information:
Miro Full licenses allow users to create, edit and own boards. These licenses are paid and require governance and control.
Miro Full licenses have an update process every 60 days, if no activity is detected as a Full license user, it will be changed to Free restricted (of course, it can be requested again).
Please, include the related context where the license is needed.
- Approval information:
For approval, please provide the full name of your Approval (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.
NOTE: If you are L6 or above, you don't need an approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.
- Approval name: Antonio Rossi (Rome) (D-B79K)
- Project Engagement:: Tech Solutions Ltd - Community Innovation (UG-123456)
- Project Element:: Tech Solutions Ltd - Community Innovation 2023 (UG123456-001)
- Please, read carefully the above Policy in the Condition and Documents section. I agree with the above Policy:: Yes I read carefully and understood. I agree with the above policy.

baseline.answer:
Hello,

To investigate this, please provide:

- The name of the application or platform where the boards are located
- The board name or link
- The exact error message or a screenshot
- Whether you can open existing boards but cannot edit them, or cannot access the boards at all

Once we have this information, we can check the relevant permissions before your workshop.

- General Instructions:
Please provide the full name of your GFT employee manager (L6 or above). If they are unavailable, please provide an alternative contact to complete this request.

- Computer name information:
Below you will find the computers Group IT has already assigned to you, the available names may not match the one on the label of your PC.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

If your PC is not in the list, please ensure to select Not in the list (PC) and place the name of your computer in the Other Computer Name field, in that case, ensure to fill that field.
- Computer Name: GFT-bXr4iJc5Tz6 (PC)
- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
Python
Jupyter
PIP
Python libraries
Python IDE
- Justification, including the list of software/actions that requires you to have admin Rights:
Python
Jupyter
PIP
Python libraries
Python IDE
- Important Information:
The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rigths are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
?

- General Instructions:

NOTE: If you are L6 and above, you don't need a manager approval. Therefore please add your own name as the approver.

To identify your computer name pls check the Device Name in the company portal application or open a cmd command window and write hostname.

- Other Computer name:
- Computer System: Windows
- Additional information:
Granting permanent local admin rights increases the risk for the harming integrity of your working device, GFT & client infrastructure, as an attacker or malicious software can misuse your privileged user account for serious impact, as changing system settings, installing system-level software or steal confidential information, like passwords.

Permanent admin rights should only be requested, if you need it for regular repeating tasks for daily business (please provide reason in ticket request, it will not approved without proper justification).
Temporary admin rights for a short period of time or for one-time software installation if it could not be carried out by Group IT.

Some clients requirements demands us to not work with local admin rights, it is highly important that you check prior with your manager that you do not violate client contract by your request.
- List clients and projects you work on.:
IBEF Max Mara

The provided local admin rights will require to be renewed after 12 Months after the approval. A new request will be required at that time if those rights are still needed.
- GFT Local Admin Rights Policy:
Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.
✔️ Only personnel who are authorized and hold LAR privileges may install software on their assigned workstation.
✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

- The following types of software may be installed:
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages

Local Administration Rights (LAR) allows a user to operate their assigned workstation system with elevated privileges; this means, installing or customizing software not found on the base GFT Group system installations.

The following conditions and rules apply when using LAR privileges on a system provisioned by and used within the GFT Group environment:
✔️ Only personnel from GFT Group may request LAR privileges.

✔️ Only software intended and related to support activities and the needs of GFT Group is eligible and may be installed.

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GFT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GFT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license ([URL placeholder]) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

? Alter the base GFT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e.viruses and malware)
